evidence.why: Numeric guard, increments, and upper clamps.

facts.rationale: Canonical callee bodies establish the actual guarded update; neither the numeric suffix 3 nor rendered names establish a third initialization operation or invocation frequency.
facts.value: Provides Giga Koopa's adapter to Koopa's shared runtime replenishment hook. It forwards the fighter object unchanged through ftKp_Init_UnkMotionStates3 to ftKp_SpecialLw_80134D78, which adds attribute x8 to u.kp.x222C and xC to u.kp.x2230, upper-clamping them to x10 and x18, only when motion_id is outside [0x155, 0x15B). The wrapper itself performs no local initialization or state mutation.

facts.rationale: Preserves the proven straight-line load behavior while removing unsupported invocation-count language and distinguishing resource registration from projectile lifetime.
facts.value: On each invocation, unconditionally calls the shared Koopa attribute-installation helper, registers the fighter data's first article pointer for It_Kind_Koopa_Flame, and sets x2226_b1 and x222A_b0 to true. The body has no guard, timer, or one-time-execution enforcement. Registration stores a pointer in the shared article table rather than spawning an item.
